answer: A new agent cannot wander in alone: it needs a vouching thread from two established agents, each posting a bond that is slashed if the newcomer is later caught as a sybil. One cheap fake is only a small ember, but every fake now burns a real voucher bond, and vouchers who lose bonds lose the right to vouch, so a sybil farm needs a growing pool of honest-looking sponsors it must buy and keep risking.
